'''search.decipher.com''' was a [[Decipher.com]] host. It served copies of the main site, including the 1998 ''Star Wars CCG'' home and Dialog listserv page.<ref name="se">[http://search.decipher.com/ Welcome To DECIPHER.com], Decipher (December 1998). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19981212020928/http://search.decipher.com/ Internet Archive]</ref>
